Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS � Participating bidders must have a registered office located within the state of Kerala and hold an active Goods and Services Tax (GST) number issued by the Indian government. A valid local office license under Kerala state regulations is also mandatory. Relevant supporting documents must be provided for verification purposes. � The bidder must hold GST registration in the same state as the consignee, which is also the jurisdiction of the bid-inviting authority. The GST certificate should reflect the name of the bidding entity. Bidders are r equired to provide proof of having monthly regular GST returns for the past three years. � Only Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) or their authorized representatives are eligible to parti cipate. If submitting the bid as an authorized dealer, a Manufacturer Authorization Certificate specifically r eferring to this tender must be submitted. � All quoted products must be current models that are still in production and supported by the manufact urer. Bidders must confirm that no quoted items are classified as end-of-life and that manufacturer support is ongoing. � Bidders should have been actively engaged on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal for at least the past three years. Appropriate documents verifying this period of activity must be attached. � A minimum rating of 4.5 stars or higher on the GeM portal is required, along with user and buyer revie ws reflecting consistent 5-star feedback. Additionally, the bidder must possess a valid GeM Gold or Silver Certificate. All supporting documents for these credentials must be included. � The bidder must acknowledge and accept the Additional Terms and Conditions (ATCs) of this procurem ent process. A signed letter on company letterhead, indicating compliance with the ATCs as defined by the buyer, must be submitted. � Bidder must have minimum 9 Crores business in Gem (attach proof) � A declaration must be provided on the bidder’s letterhead stating that the company has not been black

listed or debarred from government or public procurement in the last five years. � Products offered must strictly conform to the technical specifications mentioned in the tender. Any vari ance from the required specifications will lead to disqualification during technical scrutiny. The bidder mus t submit a compliance statement on their letterhead, confirming adherence to the bidding specifications. � The purchaser holds the authority to accept or reject any bids based on a comparative market analysis of the offered products. � OEM/Seller should have registered office in kerala-furnish GST Certificate of the bidder from same � The brands quoted must enjoy a good reputation, strong industry presence, and be recognized for perf ormance, reliability, and quality. Preference will be given to brands with positive customer experiences an d a substantial footprint in the market. � Bidders must show a proven history of supplying Desktop Computers, Printers and UPS from the quote d OEM to central/state government departments or PSUs in Kerala over the past three years via the GeM p ortal. � The bidder must establish a service mechanism within Kerala capable of addressing issues with the pro ducts within 48 hours of a reported breakdown. � An Escalation Matrix including contact phone numbers for service support must be submitted by the bi dder or OEM. � The OEM must have a service centre in the Consignee's District. Proof of the same must be submitted along with the bid documents. � If there is any deviation from technical or general requirements specified in the tender, bidders must d isclose this explicitly in a technical deviation statement, which should accompany the bid submission. � The bidder must have completed at least ten individual work orders of similar products, from the quote d OEM/brand through the GeM portal. These must have been executed within Kerala. � Bidder must be certified Gem Portal user ie atleast possess a Silver or Gold Certificate and attach the s ame � Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF): Bid-specific Manufacturer Authorisation Form (MAF) from OEM is mandatory with contact no. & email for verification. Bids without MAF will be rejected. � OEM brand should be established in India for a minimum of 20 years (proof - TM/brand registration). B idder should be OEM or its Authorised Dealer with minimum 10 years' experience in similar supply. Refurbi shed/Assembled products not allowed .
